lakekeeper:rest-spec-support:current.notes: Fully implements the standard Iceberg REST Catalog API specification, including vended credentials and S3 remote signing.

lakekeeper:v2-spec-support:current.notes: Format v2 is the default for Lakekeeper-managed tables; per-warehouse policies can pin or restrict the allowed format versions.

lakekeeper:v3-spec-support:current.notes: Supports format v3 tables including the variant data type and v2-to-v3 migration, with per-warehouse format-version policies enforced on create, commit and upgrade.
caveats: Engines connecting to Lakekeeper must also understand v3 to read or write these tables

lakekeeper:managed-offering:current.notes: No managed, zero-ops service today: Lakekeeper Cloud is waitlist/coming-soon and Lakekeeper+ is self-hosted enterprise. Self-run only.

lakekeeper:serves-own-irc:current.notes: Full Iceberg REST spec, read and write, with credential vending for S3, Azure and GCS.

lakekeeper:rw-foreign-irc:current.notes: No bundled query engine, so the catalog cannot itself read or write foreign tables over IRC: foreign-table access needs separate compute.
caveats: The source rubric scores 'no engine' as 0 (BYO compute), so this is recorded as not supported rather than unknown

lakekeeper:federation-broker:current.notes: No catalog-of-catalogs brokering: stepped back from an earlier non-standard implementation and proposed a standard /events endpoint (Apache Iceberg PR #12584). Current focus is governance federation (many engines, one catalog), not catalog federation.

lakekeeper:governance-cred-vending:curre.notes: OpenFGA fine-grained authorization plus credential vending.
